main_decision: Use objective supervision from new graph-first procedural underground worlds. Do not use AI-only or contrastive-only learning as the core method.

student_input.raw_fact_source: timestamped LiDAR point cloud, pose, and true ray origin
student_input.derived_candidate: 40 m x 40 m, 0.25 m/cell, 160 x 160 current plus 4-second causal terrain-relative BEV

teacher.source: complete geometry, robot footprint, collision checker, and frozen local-planner contract

novelty_warning: Synthetic underground LiDAR plus CNN exit detection plus topological navigation is prior art; the contribution must be planner-consistent partial-observation structure and uncertainty, stable exit-stub topology, M-TARE global replacement, and multi-robot allocation.
